There exist a standard Borel measurable space \((\mathcal V,\mathscr V)\), a \(\mathcal V\)-valued random element \(V\), and a jointly measurable map \(h:\mathcal A\times\mathcal X\times\mathcal V\to[-B_Y,B_Y]\) such that \(V\perp A\mid X\) and
\[
 P\bigl(Y(a)=h(a,X,V)\text{ for every }a\in\mathcal A\bigr)=1.
\]
